terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: The rules for using Finanly, written in plain language.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
paragraphs: By creating your account you state that you have read, understood and accepted these Terms of Use and the Privacy Notice, in the version shown above. If you disagree with anything here, please do not use the service.
As proof of consent, the sign-up stores the accepted version and the moment of acceptance, as required by the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD, art. 8, §1).

sections.title: 2. What Finanly is — and what it is not
paragraphs: Finanly is a personal finance organisation tool. You record entries, income, goals and limits, and the app shows balance, indicators and projections calculated from what you enter.

Finanly is not a financial institution, does not connect to banks, does not move money and does not make investments. It also does not provide financial, accounting, legal or investment advice: the numbers support your decision, and the decision is always yours.

sections.title: 3. Minimum age and your account
paragraphs: The service is intended for people aged 18 or over. Minors may only use Finanly with the specific written consent of a parent or legal guardian (LGPD, art. 14).

You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for telling us immediately if you notice unauthorised use of your account. Each person should keep a single account, and the data recorded in it must be yours — do not record third parties' financial data without authorisation.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You agree not to use Finanly for unlawful activities, to attempt to bypass technical or security limits, to access other people's accounts, or to extract data from the service automatically (for example scraping or reverse engineering).
Misuse may lead to account suspension, without prejudice to any legal measures available.

sections.title: 5. WhatsApp linked to your account
paragraphs: You may link a WhatsApp number to record expenses by message. While the link exists, the bot replies only to that number and the replies include data from your account (for example, the balance). The number must therefore be yours and correct.
You can unlink the number at any time under Profile › Privacy and your data. Once unlinked, the bot stops replying and the number is removed from your profile.

sections.title: 6. Availability, backup and accuracy
paragraphs: Finanly is provided as is. We work to keep the service available and your data intact, but interruptions, maintenance and failures can happen. We recommend exporting your data periodically under Profile › Privacy and your data.

Indicators, the financial diagnosis and projections are calculations derived from the data you record. They do not replace statements, invoices or official documents, and guarantee no financial result.

sections.title: 7. Termination and account deletion
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time, without justification and at no cost, under Profile › Privacy and your data. Deletion is immediate and irreversible: profile, entries, income, goals, budgets and cards are erased.

We may suspend or terminate accounts that breach these Terms, that were created with false information, or that put the service or other people at risk. In that case you will be informed through the available channels, where possible.

sections.title: 8. Changes, applicable law and contact
paragraphs: These Terms may change. Relevant changes get a new version, are announced in the application, and acceptance is requested again when the change is material. The current version and date appear at the top of this document.

Brazilian law applies, in particular the LGPD (Law 13.709/2018), the Internet Civil Rights Framework (Law 12.965/2014) and, where applicable, the Consumer Protection Code. Questions about these Terms: {{email}}. For privacy and personal data matters, contact the DPO listed in the Privacy Notice.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.subtitle: Which data Finanly processes, why, with whom it is shared and how you stay in control.

sections.title: 1. Who processes your data
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is {{nome}} ({{documento}}), acting in {{endereco}} — this is the person who decides how and why data is processed.
The Data Protection Officer (LGPD, art. 41) is the communication channel between you, the controller and the ANPD. Reach the DPO at {{email}}.

sections.title: 2. Which data we process
paragraphs: Account data: name, email address and password (stored only as a hash, never in readable text). Optionally, the WhatsApp number you link.

Financial data you record: description, amount, date and category of entries; income; goals and their contributions; monthly budget limits per category; credit cards (name, limit, closing and due days).
Technical data: server access and error logs, IP address and session identifiers, used for security, fraud prevention and running the service.

We do not ask for or process sensitive data (LGPD, art. 5, II) — such as health data, biometrics, racial origin or religious belief — and we collect no payment data, because there is no billing inside the application.

sections.title: 3. Why we process it and on which legal basis
paragraphs: Performance of a contract (LGPD, art. 7, V): creating and keeping your account, storing your entries and goals, calculating balance, indicators and projections, and answering through the linked WhatsApp number.

Consent (LGPD, art. 7, I): using the WhatsApp number with the bot and accepting these documents, both recorded with version and date. You can withdraw consent by unlinking the number or deleting the account.

Legitimate interest (LGPD, art. 7, IX): service security, abuse prevention, request rate limits, error logs and improving features — always limited to what is necessary and never used for advertising.
Compliance with a legal or regulatory obligation (LGPD, art. 7, II) and regular exercise of rights (art. 7, VI): when we must comply with an authority's order or defend ourselves in proceedings.

We do not use your data for advertising, we do not sell it, and we do not make automated decisions that affect your interests without the possibility of review (LGPD, art. 20). The financial diagnosis shown on the dashboard is informative and you can challenge it at any time.

sections.title: 4. With whom we share it
paragraphs: We share data only with operators that run the service on our behalf, for the time and to the extent necessary, and always under confidentiality and LGPD-compliant processing obligations (art. 39): {{operadores}}.
Data may also be provided to public authorities when there is a legal requirement, a request from an investigation body or a court order. In those cases we inform you, unless legally prohibited.

sections.title: 5. International transfer
paragraphs: Hosting and messaging operators may process data on servers outside Brazil, especially in the United States. The LGPD (arts. 33 to 36) allows international transfer when the controller provides guarantees of compliance with the principles and data subject rights.

Those guarantees are formalised through specific contractual clauses with each provider, as set out in ANPD Resolution No. 19/2024. By using Finanly you are aware that data may be processed in those locations, always under the same protection obligations set by Brazilian law.

sections.title: 6. How long we keep your data
paragraphs: Account and financial data: for as long as your account exists. When you delete the account, this data is erased immediately and irreversibly, and we keep no copy of the financial history.

Session and password recovery credentials: renewal tokens last up to 30 days and recovery tokens 1 hour. Once expired, they are removed by a daily purge routine — expired data does not stay in the database.

Application and security logs: kept for up to 6 months, with personal data masked (for example, the email appears as gu***@domain.com) whenever the record does not require full identification. After that period they are discarded.
If there is a legal obligation or a need to exercise rights, we may keep the strict minimum for longer, informing you about the period and the purpose (LGPD, arts. 15 and 16).

sections.title: 7. Your rights and how to exercise them
paragraphs: The LGPD (art. 18) gives you the right to: confirmation that we process your data; access to it; correction of incomplete or outdated data; anonymisation, blocking or erasure of unnecessary or excessive data; portability; erasure of data processed with consent; information about who we share data with; information about whether you may refuse consent and the consequences; and withdrawal of consent.

Inside the application, under Profile › Privacy and your data, you already exercise the main ones: download all your data in a file, delete the account and the history, and unlink the WhatsApp number.
For any other request, write to the DPO. We reply within 15 days from the request (LGPD, art. 19). If you are not satisfied, you may petition the Brazilian Data Protection Authority (ANPD).

sections.title: 8. How we protect your data
paragraphs: We adopt technical and administrative measures to protect your data (LGPD, art. 46): passwords stored only as a BCrypt hash; sessions with short-lived tokens and controlled renewal; per-user isolation in every query, so no account can ever access another's data; request rate limits against brute force attempts; a closed allow-list of origins allowed to call the API; encrypted connections (HTTPS) and security headers on the site; and error logs without personal data in clear text.

If a security incident occurs that may cause relevant risk or harm to you, we will notify you and the ANPD, as required by the LGPD (art. 48) and the Security Incident Communication Regulation (ANPD Resolution No. 15/2024), together with the measures taken to contain and fix the issue.

sections.title: 9. Cookies and browser storage
paragraphs: Finanly uses no advertising or behavioural analytics cookies, and no third-party cookies, which is why you will not find cookie consent banners here.

We store in your browser's local storage only what is needed to work: your session tokens, your name and email to display in the interface, the theme (light or dark) and the chosen language. You can erase this data by clearing the site storage — that ends the session and you will need to sign in again.

sections.title: 10. Minors and changes to this notice
paragraphs: The service is intended for people aged 18 or over. We do not intentionally process data of children or adolescents; if we identify an account under those conditions without consent from the legal guardian, it will be closed and the data erased (LGPD, art. 14).

This notice may be updated to reflect changes in the service or in the law. The version and date always appear at the top of the document and, when the change is material, we announce it in the application and ask for acceptance again.
Questions about this notice or about how your data is processed: {{email}}.
